phases.name: Phase 1.1 - Core System Optimization
phases.description: Hibernation/Fast Startup disable, power plan, Explorer/indexing, and privacy tweaks.

steps.name: Registry Backup (Quick)
steps.description: Create timestamped backups of keys modified during Phase 1.1.

steps.name: System Optimization
steps.description: Disable hibernation, Fast Startup, SysMain, set fixed pagefile, and create AbeOS power plan.

steps.name: Explorer & Indexing
steps.description: Optimize Windows Search index roots and File Explorer responsiveness.

steps.name: Privacy & UI Cleanup
steps.description: Disable login tips, Get Started app, Spotlight, and other distractions.

phases.name: Phase 1.2 - Hardware Drivers & BIOS
phases.description: Driver installs, BIOS updates, and GPU fan profile exports.

steps.name: Install Driver Packages
steps.description: Runs each enabled installer listed in configs/installers/drivers.json

phases.name: Phase 1.3 - Developer Environment
phases.description: WSL2, Node.js, Docker Desktop, Python/AI, Java, C++, and terminal provisioning.

steps.name: Install Windows Development Tools
steps.description: Install Git, VS Code, PowerShell 7, Windows Terminal, Oh My Posh, Docker Desktop, Python, GitHub CLI, Java JRE via winget/choco.
steps.notes: Requires restart after Docker Desktop installation

steps.name: Configure WSL2
steps.description: Create /etc/wsl.conf with systemd enabled and Windows PATH disabled (CRITICAL: LF line endings).
steps.notes: Requires WSL shutdown and restart: wsl --shutdown

steps.name: Install WSL/Linux Development Tools
steps.description: Install build-essential, git, curl, wget, unzip, and other core Linux development tools.

steps.name: Install Node.js/JavaScript Stack
steps.description: Install NVM (Windows + WSL), Node.js 20/24 LTS, pnpm, yarn. Auto-remove system Node.js. Configure npm global prefix to ~/.npm-global.
steps.notes: CRITICAL: Sets npm global prefix to prevent Windows PATH contamination

steps.name: Install Web Development Packages
steps.description: Install TypeScript, Vite, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, tRPC, Zod, ESLint, Prettier globally via npm.

steps.name: Install Python/AI Toolchain
steps.description: Install Python 3.12, pip, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, NumPy, Pandas, Jupyter, scikit-learn.

steps.name: Install Miniconda
steps.description: Install Miniconda package manager for Python environment management.

steps.name: Install AI CLI Tools
steps.description: Install Anthropic Claude CLI, OpenAI CLI, Google Gemini CLI, and Aider AI coding assistant.

steps.name: Install Java/JVM Stack
steps.description: Install SDKMAN!, Java 21/17/11, Gradle, and Maven for JVM development.

steps.name: Install C/C++ Toolchain
steps.description: Install GCC, G++, Clang, GDB, Valgrind, and other C/C++ development tools.

steps.name: Install VS Code Extensions
steps.description: Install 80+ VS Code extensions for web development, Python, C++, Docker, and more.

steps.name: Setup Bash Profile
steps.description: Link AbeOS custom bash profile to ~/.bashrc. Auto-detects AbeOS location (Windows /mnt/c or Linux ~/AbeOS).

steps.name: Setup PowerShell Profile
steps.description: Unify all PowerShell profiles (OneDrive, VS Code, system-wide) to load single core configuration.
steps.notes: Adds Claude CLI to PATH, fixes profile fragmentation

phases.name: Phase 2 - Music Production
phases.description: DAWs, VST orchestration, and audio routing automation.
